name: Sentry Point
summary: At Sentry Point, Theramore's forces watch the causeway to their island citadel. From the mainland edge of Dustwallow Marsh, the human watchtower overlooks traffic in both directions.

sections.title: The Gates of Theramore
sections.body: Sentry Point guards the western end of the bridge between Theramore Isle and Dustwallow Marsh. From its stone scout tower, Theramore's forces watch the swamp road. They guard the mainland approach to the island city and watch for marsh beasts and Horde raiders.

faq.q: What is Sentry Point used for?
faq.answer: Sentry Point warns Theramore Isle of approaching threats and checks traffic on the swamp road. Its guards watch travelers and alert the city guards when danger nears.
Theramore's forces man and maintain Sentry Point under Lady Jaina Proudmoore and her military officers.

faq.q: Is Sentry Point safe for Horde travelers?
aliases: can horde go to sentry point
faq.answer: No. Lady Jaina Proudmoore seeks peace with the Horde, but Sentry Point's guards protect Alliance territory and attack Horde travelers who trespass.

angles.text: For travelers crossing Dustwallow Marsh's dangerous bogs, Sentry Point marks the welcoming threshold to the safety of Theramore Isle.
Sentry Point's guarded tower makes Theramore's military presence on the Kalimdor mainland plain to approaching Horde scouts.
